h1: The 8 Best Color E-Readers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: eight color E Ink e-readers from PocketBook, Bigme and Musnap, compared on storage, Android support and size.
summary: The PocketBook Verse Pro Color is the well-rounded pick, with a waterproof body and Kaleido 3 color screen. The Musnap Ocean C offers the biggest color display with handwriting, and the Bigme B6 models are the budget route into Android color reading.
intro: Color E Ink looks tempting, but the real purchase is the software around it. Many of these readers run full Android, which means more apps and more flexibility, but also more setup than a plain e-book device.

We reviewed eight color e-readers from PocketBook, Bigme and Musnap and ranked them on screen type, storage, Android support, waterproofing and price tier. We used the spec sheets only and make no claims about screen sharpness.

products.name: PocketBook Verse Pro Color, 6" E Ink Kaleido 3 Display, IPX8 Waterproof
products.verdict: A waterproof, compact reader with a Kaleido 3 color screen.
products.description:
The Verse Pro Color has a 6-inch E Ink Kaleido 3 color display, IPX8 waterproofing, text-to-speech and Bluetooth.

It leads because waterproofing and audio features set it apart from the Android-based picks, which focus on apps and storage.

Buy it for a durable, pool-and-bath-friendly reader. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.
products.idealFor: Readers who want a durable, simple device.

products.name: Musnap Neo 2C 64GB+4GB Colour eBook Reader, 6" Color E Ink
products.verdict: The newer-generation Musnap with 64GB and 4GB RAM.
products.description:
The Neo 2C has a 6-inch color E Ink screen, a newer-generation design, 64GB of storage and 4GB of RAM, with third-party app support.

It ranks above the Neo C because it is the newer generation, with the same storage and memory.

Buy it if you want room for a big library. It sits in the $200-500 bucket.

products.name: Musnap Ocean C 64GB+4GB 7" Color eBook Reader, Supports Handwriting
products.verdict: A 7-inch color screen with handwriting support.
products.description:
The Ocean C has a 7-inch color E Ink display, 64GB of storage, 4GB of RAM and handwriting support.

It ranks third because the Neo 2C is newer, but the 7-inch screen is the largest here.

Buy it for comics, PDFs and notes. It costs in the $200-500 bucket.

products.name: Musnap Neo C 64GB+4GB Colour eBook Reader, 6" Color E Ink
products.verdict: Ample storage and RAM in a 6-inch color reader.
products.description:
The Neo C has a 6-inch color E Ink screen, 64GB of storage, 4GB of RAM and third-party app support.

It ranks fourth because the Neo 2C is the newer generation with matching specs.

Choose it if you want the same hardware class for less. It sits in the $200-500 bucket.

products.name: Bigme B6 Color eReader, 6" Android E-Ink, 4G+64GB
products.verdict: Android color reading with 4G data and 64GB.
products.description:
This Bigme B6 has a 6-inch color E Ink screen, Android 14, 4G connectivity and 64GB of storage.

It ranks fifth because the Musnap models list more RAM, but this is the only reader here with named 4G.

Buy it if you want cellular data. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.
products.idealFor: Readers wanting data on the go.

products.name: Bigme B6 Color E-Reader, Android 14, Translator & Voice Recorder
products.verdict: Adds a translator and voice recorder to color reading.
products.description:
This Bigme B6 runs Android 14 on a color E Ink screen and adds a translator function and voice recorder.

It ranks sixth because those extras help a narrow group, and the 4G model has wider reach.

Buy it for language learning or notes. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.

products.name: Bigme B6 Color eReader, Octa-Core CPU, 2GB+32GB, Android 14
products.verdict: An octa-core budget B6 with 2GB RAM and 32GB.
products.description:
This Bigme B6 lists an octa-core CPU, 2GB RAM, 32GB of storage and Android 14, with color E Ink.

It ranks seventh because storage is lower than the 64GB models, but it is among the cheapest.

Buy it on a tight budget. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.

products.name: Bigme B6 Color Ebook Reader, 2GB+32GB Storage, Android 14, Black
products.verdict: Core Bigme color reading without extras.
products.description:
This Bigme B6 pairs color E Ink with Android 14, 2GB of RAM and 32GB of storage.

It ranks last because it adds nothing over the octa-core model, but it keeps things basic.

Buy it for simple color reading. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.

IPX8 means it can handle submersion. Look for the IPX rating.

finalTake: The PocketBook Verse Pro Color is the best all-round reader. Choose the Musnap Ocean C for the big screen, and a Bigme B6 for budget Android.
